purpose: 80 distinct authored scenario candidates for independent source/rubric review and later execution against final released deterministic rules. This is JSON data, not application code, tests, execution evidence or publication approval.

globalInterpretation.factsStateEncoding: Known values are literals. Unknown, unanswered and not_applicable use explicit status/value objects; none means false or zero.
globalInterpretation.sourceContextIsScenarioData: Source-expiry, draft-only and unsupported-period conditions are synthetic negative-test preconditions. Authoring publication status is recorded only in artifact/source-candidate metadata, not supplied as a contradictory normal-case runtime fact.
globalInterpretation.outcomesAreConditional: Expected national outcomes are candidates, assuming independently approved source/rule scope unless the case explicitly tests a hold. All cases remain unexecuted and require review.
globalInterpretation.nationalVersusLocal: These four candidates are national only. No state/FCT/LGA rule pack is supplied. Lagos, FCT and Bayelsa are coverage dimensions, not proof of local regulatory coverage.
globalInterpretation.noNegativeCertification: Not indicated refers only to one candidate under these answers; it never means no legal duties or full compliance.
globalInterpretation.notFullRUL008Coverage: 80 authored cases across four narrow candidates do not establish the full 80-case RUL-008 acceptance scope, coverage, independent AI challenge, execution or all critical passes. Additional source-backed requirements and reviewed expected outcomes remain necessary.
globalInterpretation.separateEvaluationSuites: These candidates do not count as the 60 customer-AI or 60 editorial cases.
globalInterpretation.historicalComparisons: Later execution must preserve prior snapshots and user-created tasks; updated outcomes must state changed facts/source context rather than overwrite history.
globalInterpretation.executionBindingRequired: Before execution, bind each normal case to actual immutable reviewed and released rule/source versions. No binding or release is claimed here. Held-state cases intentionally exercise source/rule eligibility failures and must not inject a fictional released version.
